moment.zh: 2014 年世界杯化身「门卫」，频频冲出禁区像清道夫一样解围，重新定义了门将。
moment.en: At the 2014 World Cup he became the 'sweeper-keeper', charging out like a libero — redefining the position.

quote.zh: 门将，也可以是进攻的第一发起者。
quote.en: A keeper can be the first attacker, too.

honors.zh: 世界杯冠军（2014）· 多座欧冠
honors.en: World Cup winner (2014) · multiple Champions Leagues
